name: manpu
title: Manpu
description: Emotion marks drawn for the kit (manpu): anger vein, sweat drop, surprise lines, question mark, sparkle, gloom lines, love, sigh. Ink strokes that pop in; anger and sparkle keep a small stepped motion. Decorative by default; pass label to make it spoken.

meta.usage:
import { Manpu } from "@/components/manga/manpu"

<Manpu kind="sweat" />
<Manpu kind="anger" label="Angry" />

props.name: animated
props.description: Pop in, plus a stepped motion for some marks.

props.name: label
props.description: Spoken meaning; without it the mark is aria-hidden.
